retrievalProfile.description: A stark, low-key black and white portrait featuring a central subject with high-contrast shadows and metallic highlights.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white photography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a young man against a neutral gray background. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows on one side of the face while highlighting the texture of the hair and the metallic sheen of a layered Cuban link chain. The overall mood is serious and intense, emphasized by a desaturated, high-contrast black and white palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark silhouette of the clothing and the neutral background
Highlighting of the metallic jewelry against the dark torso
Shadow play defining the facial structure and brow
Texture of the hair contrasting with the smooth skin and background
coreInvariants: High-detail texture in hair and jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium-close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright metallic chain serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright jewelry, moves up to the face, and follows the gaze toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space above and to the sides of the head creates a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (highlights on jewelry and skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a man with textured hair and a thick chain, using low-key lighting against a plain gray backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use bold, minimalist sans-serif typography in white or light gray, positioned in the negative space above the head.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional with deep shadows?

mustAchieve: Distinct separation between subject and background
avoid: Loss of detail in the hair texture

postGenerationChecks: Verify the chain has metallic luster
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio lighting + Monochrome + Urban Subject + High Contrast = Dramatic Portrait
